'''Minister of Security''' was a position in the government of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The Minister of Security was responsible for overseeing the customs office and other security-related bureaucracies on the planet. [[Gideon Tarkin]] held the position in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
